content: Pɔl anà Silasi u Tɛsalɔnikà
Pɔl anà Silasi bàlyaaŋ kà Amfipolisi anà Apɔlɔni, ba bàkɔlà Tɛsalɔnikà. Akun Ayudà bàkäl anà ndwà a nköŋ aba.
Pɔl kàbilà kwo asànaa nkääl ande. An'saba an'tär màlääb, nde kàkäl muyäämà anà ba ntɔn Ndaa Aŋàsɔn,
wàmubuul anà muswaŋ naa Klistɔ kàkyer alàman mpay anà kàkyer alàwiyà uboo a akü. Klistɔ wà Yɛsu wa alàkyäänà mɛ wà.
Ndam a baar uboo a ba bàkyey ba, ba bàtüüb anà Pɔl anà Silasi, anà un'kàbɔ a Angɛlɛki bàfasyäŋà Nzam, anà akaar a nkaay mbɔɔn.

Wɛɛ Ayudà bàwem un'köl, ba bàwɛl baar a bunàbun bàmbàmbärà kà an'balàbal ntɔn musà binköŋ mbɔɔn uboo a un'sɛŋ anà lingyoomà uboo a bul. Ba bàkàyɔl u ndwà a Yasɔn, ntɔn muleŋ Pɔl anà Silasi anà mukasyen akà un'sɛŋ a baar.

Ba bamɛn anki, apan ba bàwɛl Yasɔn anà ndam a atɔŋ bàkäl anà nde, ba batwääl akà abyääl a bul, bàmusà in'kwɛŋ anà mutɛn naa: « Baar bà ban'twaal lingyoomà u mɛɛn manswà, wɛɛ ŋàbawà ba ban'yàkɔlà apà!
Yasɔn kawɛl u ndwà ande. Ba banswà bàkwen anki mulab in'kɔɔn a Sɛzar, ba bàmutɛɛnà naa we anà mfum asin ikɔb ande Yɛsu. »
Ndaa ayi yàtwääl lingyoomà akà un'sɛŋ a baar anà akà abyääl a bul.
Ungö muwal nkwiy kà an'kɔɔ a Yasɔn anà mà baar bumwɛy, ba waa bawɛy.
Pɔl anà Silasi u Bɛrɛ
U mpib, atɔŋ bàtöm Pɔl anà Silasi u Bɛrɛ. Umpal bàtöl ba, ba bàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà.

Ayudà a Bɛrɛ bàkäl anà mpem aŋàbwaŋ akwànaa Ayudà a Tɛsalɔnikà. Ba bàwɛl Ndaa unsà mansyäär, ba sye bàfasyeebà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn ilä byanswà ntɔn muyöb naa nkye indiir bakyäänà byàkäl ndandaa.
Baar mbɔɔn uboo a ba bàsi làkwikilà, anà akaar angɛlɛki a nkaay, anà abaal mbɔɔn.
Wɛɛ mpal bàyöb Ayudà a Tɛsalɔnikà naa Pɔl wàmukyäänà ndaa a Nzam sye u Bɛrɛ, ba bàyi ntɔn musà lingyoomà uboo a baar banswà.
Apan, làgyägyä, atɔŋ bàkàswà Pɔl u ntsü a ngyäl a kölàköl, wɛɛ akà Silasi anà Tumàtɛ, ba bàsàsal paa.
Baar bàsyen Pɔl, bàkàtsü kà Atɛn. Ungö bàyàfurà ba, ba bàkyään Silasi anà Tumàtɛ nswɛɛŋ katööm Pɔl: nde kalɔ̈m naa ba bun'läb agyägyä.
Pɔl kà Atɛn
Umpal kàkäl Pɔl mudilà ba kà Atɛn, mpem ande yàlalà mbaa muman naa bul la làkäl aŋàyɔl a itɛk.
Nde kàyäämà anà Ayudà anà baar mpa abà Ayudà abà bàfasyäŋà Nzam uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, anà baar banswà kàbweeyà nde abà kà un'syäl ilä byanswà.

Ndam a baar a an'yeerà, baar a Epikür anà baar a Stɔyi bàyäämà anà nde. Amwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: « Ŋamun awà ininà ukwen mutɛn? » Bumwɛy naa: « Nde ayàkal un'lɔɔŋ a bànzam a ingyey » ntɔn nde kàkyäänà Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là Yɛsu anà ngwiiyà a akü.
Apan waa bun'kör, bun'syen kà un'syäl a Arɔpazɛ, waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Nkye bi ikyàkwo muyöb, an'lɔɔŋ nà màkün ayikyään ngye mà?
Ntɔn ngye awà mukyäänà bi indiir a ingyey. Bi ikwen muyöb naa bya iswaŋà aben. »
Abun, baar a Atɛn banswà anà angyey bàfàkal kà Atɛn, taaŋ aba mbɔɔn làlyaaŋà mutɛn itàkal muwem indiir akün.
Pɔl kàkäl umbär uboboo a Arɔpazɛ, waa kàtɛn naa: « Abaal a Atɛn, mɛ an'man naa mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ wanswà wà unsà inzaam.

Ntɔn an'yilyaaŋ mɛ uboo a bul abɛ anà an'syebà mɛ indiir a in'kyɛɛl abɛ, mɛ an'man idwà imwɛy bàkyàsɔn naa: "Akà nzam mpa bàyöb baar!" Wɛɛ nde wa làfàsyänà bɛ wà anà làkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb bɛ, mɛ amàyàlakyään wa.
Nzam awà kàkyer du anà mɛɛn anà indiir byanswà abyà uboo, nde wà Mwol a du anà mɛɛn, nde ufàkal anki uboo a ndwà a nzam ayà bàkyer kà an'kɔɔ a baar,
nde baar bàfun'bay anki, asànaa nde kà we anà mfun a undiir aben undiir. Ntɔn nde wà mbuur afàpà mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà un'swey akà baar banswà anà indiir byumwɛy.
Fà mbuur mwɛy nde kàkyer in'sɛŋ a baar ntɔn ba bàkäl udu a mɛɛn manswà, nde kàtsül an'mpaŋà anà ndel a nsi bàtöŋ ba.
Nde kàkwen naa baar bàleŋ Nzam, taaŋ lumwɛy naa ba bun'mɛn unsà ileleŋ aba. Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ nde kwɛl watɛy anà umwɛy umwɛy uboo a bi,
ntɔn: "U mbwo ande, bi ibye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, ibàmubar anà mukal." Ya yà asànaa bàtɛn asöön abɛ amwɛy naa: "Bi sye ibà itoo ande."
Undiir awun, ntɔn ibà bi itoo a Nzam, bi ikwe anki muyweer naa nde ukäl asànaa itɛk a wɔl, kyà arza anà kyà un'kul kàkyer mbuur unsà an'kyän ande.
Wɛɛ Nzam, ukɔɔn alab taaŋ a ingyöy, apanà nde wàmubel baar banswà u ntsü yanswà mubuul mpem,
ntɔn nde kàkyàtsul ilä mwɛy akyà usàtsüül nde mɛɛn manswà nsaŋ unsà balàbal u mbwo a mbuur kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde, awà kaswɛŋ nde idiim mukun'wiiy kà ukwà. »
Mpal bàwem ba « ngwiiyà a akü », baar amwey waa bun'sɛɛ, wɛɛ bumwɛy bàtɛɛnà naa: « Bi iyàfawem mutɛn ndaa ayi u mbalà asin. »
Apan, Pɔl waa kàsawɛy.
Wɛɛ ndam a baar bumwɛy bàbääb anà nde, ba bàsi làkwikilà: uboo a ba, Dɛnis mbuur a Arɔbazɛ, anà un'kaar mwɛy ikɔb ande Damalis, anà baar asin sye.
